name: What are common signs that I need a roof material condition assessment?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that I need a roof material condition assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs include missing or curled shingles, granules in gutters, visible leaks inside your home, a sagging roofline, or sudden increases in energy bills. If you notice any of these issues, especially after strong winds or hail in areas like Dallas-Fort Worth, it's a good indicator that an assessment is needed. Recognizing these signs provides a Decision Factor for when to seek professional inspection. Addressing them promptly can prevent further damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for missing shingles, granules in gutters, leaks, sagging, or high energy bills, especially after DFW storms.
